title: Three Kinds of System Prompt: Comparing What AI Labs Publish About How Their Models Behave
description: AI labs publish long documents meant to shape model behavior. Some are built in during training, some set rules for whose instructions win at runtime, and some are the text a product sends with every conversation. This paper argues they are three different kinds of artifact, and compares what Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind and xAI publish, plus 25+ coding-agent products, with each source graded by how far it can be trusted.
